sources.title: History of kites — American Kitefliers Association

notes: 墨子「木鸢」、鲁班「竹鹊」等记载常被引为风筝起源，但是否即后世纸面风筝仍有讨论；军事测距等故事也难以逐一坐实。可以确定的是风筝传统源于中国，约战国前后已有飞行框架记载，纸鸢在唐宋走向娱乐化。
notes_en: Mozi’s wooden kite and Lu Ban’s bamboo “magpie” are often cited, but whether they equal later paper recreational kites is debated; military ranging stories are hard to verify case by case. The tradition is Chinese, with flying frames attested around the Warring States era and paper kites popular by Tang–Song times.
summary_zh: 风筝传统源于中国，战国前后已有木竹飞鸢记载；唐宋纸鸢成为娱乐。具体发明人与最早形态仍有争议。
summary_en: Kites originated in China, with wooden frames attested around the 5th century BCE and paper kites popular by Tang–Song times. The exact inventor and earliest form remain disputed.
summary_ja: 凧は中国に起源がある。木枠は紀元前5世紀頃に確認され、紙の凧は唐から宋に普及した。発明者と最古の形は争われている。
